description: Offre de transport du réseau Olé - Lunel Agglo (GTFS et GTFS-RT) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Lunel Agglo. Lunel Agglo’s GTFS dataset describes the public transport offer on the territory of the agglomeration community. It allows developers, mobility apps and users to access standardised information on timetables, routes, stops and transport services offered by the network. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Lunel Agglo. The portal shows the English title as "Transmission offer of the Olé - Lunel Agglo network (GTFS and GTFS-RT)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Lunel Agglo. Its keywords include mobilite-collective, transport, horaires-transport, transport-en-commun, reseau-astuce, arret-transport. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
